change.after: "returns the results of the most recent cached probe"

exposure.needed: whether operators or scripts invoke `cilium-health status --probe` (an interactive CLI call, not a workload container argument) and rely on it running a fresh synchronous probe

consequence.statement: `cilium-health status --probe` no longer runs a synchronous probe. It returns the results of the most recent cached probe instead, and the option will be removed in a future release.
consequence.remediation: Stop relying on `cilium-health status --probe` for fresh synchronous probe results, and remove it from any scripts before it is dropped in a future release.

assertion.statement: In Cilium 1.17, `cilium-health status --probe` no longer runs a synchronous probe; it is now a hidden option that returns the results of the most recent cached probe, and it will be removed in a future release.
